operation: Read-only runtime tuple collection; no qualification
bash_script:
set -eu
if /usr/bin/mountpoint -q /mnt/d; then :; else rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 32 ] || exit "$rc"; /usr/bin/mount -t drvfs D: /mnt/d -o ro || exit $?; fi
opts=$(/usr/bin/findmnt -n -o OPTIONS --target /mnt/d)
case ",$opts," in *,ro,*) ;; *) echo "D mount not read-only: $opts" >&2; exit 93;; esac
exec /usr/bin/python3.12 -I -B -S -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
